messages:
Ana: Quick share — ran a cross-GPU comparison for Llama-2-13b, Mistral-7b, and Qwen-7b across us-west1/us-east1 on A100 vs H100. grabbing perf numbers + a few surprising kernel quirks.

Mike: Nice. what seq len / batch did you use?

Ana: baseline configs: seq=2048, prompt+gen avg=512/1536, batch=4 for latency, batch=16 for throughput. quant: awq/int8 weight + per-channel scales.

Tess: posted quick chart: https://internal.charts/redwood/ml/176995 — p99 lat and tok/s across combos. highlights: H100 wins p99 for Llama and Mistral; Qwen better throughput on A100 for batch16 but p99 spikes on H100 with int8. :eyes:

Sophie: on eval set (GQA subset) quant-int8 Mistral-7b shows ~2.8% EM drop vs fp16 when using awq. Llama-2 had ~1.2% drop, Qwen ~0.9%. numbers stable across regions.

Josh: saw a kernel abort when running Qwen with rope-scaled kv-cache + int8 kernels on H100. log: ```E tensorflow: kernel_launch failed: cuLaunchKernel: illegal memory access at op=kv_cache_update``` happened at ~1.2M tokens served. A100 did not hit it.

Ana: hmm that's the rope scaling mismatch we've seen before. which kernel variant?

Josh: compiled with rtx-kernel-v3 + autopack-int8. suspect misaligned warp config.

Mike: can we reproduce with a minimal run? command i used: `./bench --model qwen-7b --gpu h100 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --quant awq`

Josh: yes repros for me with that exact command. stacktrace points at `rope_apply.cu:line 78`. adding small patch fixes it locally. patch id `c3d9f8b` (wip).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for kernel-fix/c3d9f8b on eng-runtime-hosted in us-east1 at 1769954500.

Sophie: also worth noting quality regression correlates with certain kernel fusion combos. if we force unfused attention path for Mistral int8 (disable fusion flag) EM loss drops back to ~1.1% but latency +6-8ms p99. tradeoff.

Tess: chart notes: Llama fp16 (H100) p99=42ms, throughput=520 tok/s; Llama int8 (A100) p99=58ms, throughput=480 tok/s. Mistral fp16 (H100) p99=36ms, int8 (A100) p99=49ms but EM drop. Qwen int8 (A100) throughput=610 tok/s batch16 but H100 p99 spikes to 110ms sometimes.

Ana: ops summary: 1) Josh to land kernel safety checks + warp alignment fixes (c3d9f8b -> pr). 2) Mike to add gated fallback to unfused attention for Mistral int8 in config. 3) Sophie to run extended GQA/regression suite after kernel roll. 4) Tess to update capacity docs with region sizing recommendations.

Mike: for capacity sizing proposal: recommend reserving 10% extra H100 headroom in us-east1 for Qwen-heavy workloads and prefer A100 pools for batch-heavy Mistral inference in us-west1. also add autoscale rule: if p99 > target*1.2 -> spin a hot-pool.

Josh: pushing PR now. small patch diff: ```diff --git a/rope_apply.cu b/rope_apply.cu
index 9f3..b7a
--- a/rope_apply.cu
+++ b/rope_apply.cu
@@ -74,6 +74,12 @@ __global__ void apply_rope(...){
+  // enforce 128-bit aligned loads for H100 kernels
+  if ((uintptr_t)kv % 16 != 0) return; // safe abort -> fallback path
+}
```

Ana: good. once canary confirms no regressions, we'll roll to dedicated pools. add test harness: run 100k tokens across both chips for 24h.

Sophie: i'm on regression job — i'll run awq/int8 + fp16 for GQA + a general chit-chat eval. will post numbers in thread.

Tess: i'll update the internal chart and add note about kernel combos that we should avoid in us-east1 until patch lands.

Ana: thanks team. major takeaway: kernel selection + rope alignment is driving the weird H100 p99s for Qwen; Mistral int8 has measurable quality hit so prefer unfused attention when EM sensitivity matters. follow-ups tracked in the ticket: INF-1847. :white_check_mark:
